Values at .9/.5/.1/.25 round to .105/.693/2.303/1.386. Equality of rounded .693+.693 and 1.386 is only display rounding, while the unrounded identity is exact over positive reals.", "means": "Rows (60+70+80)/3=70 and (80+90+100)/3=90; columns (60+80)/2=70,(70+90)/2=80,(80+100)/2=90. Replacing 80 by 110 in row 0: row means 80,90 and columns 70,80,105.", "matmul": "For R=[[2,1,0],[1,2,1]], W=[[10,0],[20,1],[30,4]], RW=[[40,1],[80,6]]. Each output(i,j)=sum_k R(i,k)W(k,j), so it mixes materials within a recipe, not recipes with each other. Bias [5,0] gives [[45,1],[85,6]], [8,0] gives [[48,1],[88,6]].", "derivative": "L(w)=(w-3)^2. Difference quotient [L(w+h)-L(w)]/h=2(w-3)+h. At w=1 this tends to -4; h=.1 gives -3.9 and the loss change -.39. A .1 step uses w_new=1-.1*(-4)=1.4; L_new=2.56 and L_prime=-3.2. With lr=.6: w_new=3.4 and L=.16. With lr=1.1: w_new=5.4 and L=5.76. version_observations: Initial live-notebook vs v6 scan found four later modified notebooks. Retained exact live digests and differing cell indexes in inspection-output-v1.json. Restoring only code output/count fields and builder serialization independently yields all 331 canonical v4 notebook hashes exactly. Thus the packet v4 preserved output association is verified; later v5/live output association is not claimed in this original.
